_note: Findings (spec 6.5, FR-P16): new Earth cells in the top 1% for a preset site, grouped into regions and checked in the literature in 2 rounds on 2026-11-15 (21 regions reviewed). Score and confidence are recomputed by the app; score_at_review is the score when the team reviewed it. Originals in data/reference/findings.propuesto.json.

findings.name: Eastern Pamir plateau

queries: Pamir Mars analog OR lunar analog Tashkurgan Wakhan
"Mars analog" Tajikistan OR Pamir plateau field site
帕米尔 塔什库尔干 火星 模拟 OR 类比 OR 月球
Eastern Pamir high-altitude cold desert climate permafrost study Tajikistan

findings.limits: Border area of three countries: the Afghan side (Wakhan) has very restricted access for security reasons, the Tajik side needs a GBAO permit and the Chinese side is a military border zone. There is seasonal grazing. Only tourist descriptions of a 'lunar' landscape exist, no studies.

findings.name: Southern Mongolian Altai (Bulgan)

queries: Mongolian Altai Mars analog Gobi Dzungaria planetary analogue
Junggar Basin OR Dzungarian Gobi Mars analog
Khovd Bulgan Mongolian Altai permafrost cold desert analog Mars

findings.limits: Notable seasonal steppe vegetation (0.26, the second highest of the top 5) and a smaller daily swing than the other regions (similarity 0.59). Near the Great Gobi B strictly protected area and the border, so permits are needed.

findings.name: Badakhshan mountains (Kokcha)

queries: Badakhshan Afghanistan Mars analog
Pamir Mars analog OR lunar analog Tashkurgan Wakhan
"Mars analog" Tajikistan OR Pamir plateau field site

findings.limits: The least similar region in temperature: mean 9.7 °C (similarity 0.23) and the highest vegetation of the top 5 (0.33), with farming in the valley and a town in the cell. Access is very hard today because of security and the political situation in Afghanistan.

findings.name: Putorana Plateau (southeast and north sectors)

queries: Putorana Plateau Mars analog
плато Путорана аналог Марса
Nominatim reverse geocoding 68.0 N, 97.5 E

findings.limits: A high plateau cut by canyons (888 m), not a plain with shallow ice like Arcadia; vegetation 0.49 (larch forest and tundra), the highest of the group; extremely hard access. Only a tourist mention of a 'Martian landscape' was found, and it is not cited.

findings.limits: The cell is on the coast with ice shelves nearby; the mix of sea ice and glacier can blur the signal. The cell's basaltic class should be checked against a geologic map (not checked in this review). Very hard logistics.

findings.name: Meidob volcanic field

queries: Meidob volcanic field Sudan Mars analog
Darfur Jebel Marra OR Meidob "Mars" analog volcanic Sudan planetary

findings.limits: Darfur is in an armed conflict zone (war in Sudan since 2023); field access is not possible today. It also has scoria cones and maars, explosive features uncommon on Mars, and no delta.

findings.limits: No delta or lake sediments comparable to the Jezero delta; the annual (0.87) and daily (0.87) temperature ranges are the weakest matches; young flows may be rougher than the Jezero floor. Screening by feature similarity, not geological proof.

findings.limits: The annual temperature range is the weakest match (0.72); no delta comparable to Jezero's; the basaltic class comes from a global map at 0.5 degrees and the area also has andesitic and sedimentary rock. The documented Lut analogs are aeolian (megaripples, yardangs), not basaltic floor. Screening, not geological proof.
